levels.name: Walls I
levels.desc: Cars, pallets and wire across the gaps.

levels.name: Walls II
levels.desc: Welded sheet metal and a proper gate.

levels.name: Walls III
levels.desc: Double wall with a kill corridor.

levels.name: Watchtower
levels.desc: Eyes on the street. +10 defense, scavenging risk -3%.

levels.name: Garden
levels.desc: Raised beds in the yard. +4 food a day, more with Farmers.

levels.name: Farm
levels.desc: Tilled plots and a coop. +11 food a day, much more with Farmers.

levels.name: Water collector
levels.desc: Tarps and barrels. +6 water a day plus hauling. Half in winter.

levels.name: Well
levels.desc: A hand-dug well with a pump. +14 water a day plus hauling.

levels.name: Water tower
levels.desc: A rooftop tank fed by the well and the gutters, with a sand filter. +24 water a day plus hauling.

levels.name: Infirmary
levels.desc: Cots and a clean room. Faster healing, better amputation odds.

levels.name: Workshop
levels.desc: Benches and tools. Builds 35% faster, salvages 1 material a day.

levels.name: Barracks II
levels.desc: A second floor of bunks. +10 more capacity.

levels.name: Research lab
levels.desc: A Scientist can work here. Unlocks Research.

levels.name: Tents
levels.desc: Tarps and camping tents in the yard. +8 beds. Cold and cramped (morale -1).

levels.name: Tents II
levels.desc: More tents and a mess tarp. +8 beds.

levels.name: Radio tower
levels.desc: A mast on the roof and a car battery bank. Contact camps without sending anyone, and hear trade offers.
